FAQ
In response to everyone's messages, let me explain. Due to the consideration of performance and better picture levels on all platforms, "Where Wh..?" is not using a real-time lighting scheme, so it is inevitable that there will be some imperfections in the shadow details, which is why we are reluctant to zoom in further on the picture details. notes.title: v2.4.7 released! the official version will be online soon!
notes.notes:
v2.4.7 2024.10.16
- Added - Added support for Italian, Russian, German, and Korean languages.
- Added - Access to Steam achievements
- Added - Read files from demo versions
- Improved- Changed fonts for consistent display in multiple languages, adjusted UI effects
- Improved- Shadow accuracy in some scenes
- Improved- Wishlist button added to Demo version
- Improved- Translation checking
- Fixed- Main interface title doesn't follow language switching
- Fixed - Some scene display issues

There are a lot of updates in this version, not only adding more languages support, but also changing the default fonts. Now all languages use the same font, which makes it look more coherent! When the game is officially launched, we'll share the translation files for players to suggest changes!

We expect to release the official version on the 24th of October, at which point you'll be able to inherit the Demo archive and continue playing, and achievements will be synced to the platform!

The next phase of the game is to adapt the game for Steam:

 Adding keyboard and joystick solutions.
 Adaptation for SteamDeck and other handheld platforms.
 Stabilise content for live release

We've seen some suggestions from players in the forums, and the magnifying glass idea is a cool one that we'll seriously consider. For the sake of consistency, we won't be making the game more difficult to play. Thank you to all the players who participated in the demo, we're glad to have your support!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052714/a9079f77d41338e3f27e807c9da63b042f0e16ff.png
All the best to you guys!
PitaGame

After several months of efforts to update, constantly optimize the experience and expand the content of the scene, the official version of "Where Wh..?" will be launched on Steam platform at the end of the month to meet with players.This is a cause for celebration for us as a vegetable chicken game studio.

At the NEXT FEST, we made the first two chapters of the Demo version for all players to play. The content is the same as the official version, and the official version can inherit the Demo version archive at the beginning of the game on the same device!If you are interested, welcome to join the wish list!
